requirements.title: Functional correctness
requirements.evidence_recipe: Reference API comparison, round trip, empty and boundary tests
requirements.limitation: Testing does not prove all inputs correct.

requirements.title: Initialize libsodium before use
requirements.evidence_recipe: Inspect sodium_init and test its failure seam
requirements.limitation: Real initialization failure may not be reproducible.

requirements.title: Approved key generation
requirements.evidence_recipe: Inspect key-generation API and absence of fixed keys
requirements.limitation: No empirical test proves generator entropy.

requirements.title: Fresh production nonce
requirements.evidence_recipe: Inspect randombytes_buf data flow; repeated-call test
requirements.limitation: Random nonce collisions are negligible, not impossible.

requirements.title: Authenticate before release
requirements.evidence_recipe: Tamper ciphertext, nonce, tag and AAD; wrong-key test

requirements.title: Bounded sizes and safe arithmetic
requirements.limitation: Executed paths only; ASan is not a proof.

requirements.title: Ownership and lifetime safety
requirements.evidence_recipe: Move and destruction tests, ASan, review
requirements.limitation: Does not establish safety of arbitrary C++.

requirements.title: Clear owned secret allocations
requirements.evidence_recipe: Inspect RAII cleanup and optimized code; instrument deallocation before free
requirements.limitation: No claims about all registers, caches or caller copies.

requirements.title: No wrapper secret-dependent control or indexing
requirements.evidence_recipe: Restricted source review, with approved library calls trusted
requirements.limitation: Public lengths and authentication result may affect control flow.

requirements.title: Complete controlled timing experiment
requirements.evidence_recipe: Native Windows release harness, fixed public lengths and positive/negative controls
requirements.limitation: No detected leakage is not a constant-time proof; harness pending Phase 4.

requirements.title: Explicit failure without partial output
requirements.evidence_recipe: Allocation and authentication failure tests; exception-boundary review
requirements.limitation: OS process termination is outside recoverable-error contract.

requirements.title: Reproducible Windows build
requirements.evidence_recipe: Compiler, SDK, dependency and source hashes with test logs
requirements.limitation: Passing on one profile does not pass another.
